fact: A January 2020 Treasury-commissioned status report found that the COLLOC tool was deployed in all five pilot communes and many Treasury collection offices, with title-taking and payer-tracking modules insufficiently developed, and that software and accounting practices vary between town halls.
title: Programme d'Appui à l'Amélioration des Finances Publiques au Mali (PAAMEFIP): Rapport état des lieux, Recouvrement des Ressources Fiscales et Taxes spécifiques des Collectivités Territoriales
